question: What sequence of placement must be followed for the earth-form octad and the lord of forms?
premises: The octad of earth-forms must be placed first
The lord of the forms must also be placed
Placement of the lord follows placement of the octad
inference: Having placed the octad of earth-forms, one should also place the lord of the forms.
